[element-object-id]
=== `<object-id>` Object Identifier

Unique identifier (such as a DOI or URI) for a component _within_ a document such as a standard or a journal article (for example, for a figure, table, or text box within a standard).

#### Usage/Remarks
These identifiers may be created by a standards organization, publisher, or archive, and there is no requirement that identifiers be unique.
#### Design Note

Particularly in citations, an <<element-object-id,`<object-id>`>> is used to identify parts of a document, for example, a particular section, a figure, a table, or even a specific citation (as an entity) in the document’s reference list. The <<element-pub-id,`<pub-id>`>> element may be used inside a citation to identify a cited publication.

#### Tagged Sample

##### Identifier for a graphic
[source,xml]
....
...
<fig id="F1">
 <caption>
  <title>Deaths among patients receiving day hospital care or 
   alternative services.</title>
  <p>Odds ratios of death by end of follow up were calculated by 
   fixed effects model. Heterogeneity between trials is presented 
   as &#x03C7;<sup>2</sup></p>
 </caption>
 <alt-text>Deaths in hospitals or with alternative services</alt-text>
 <graphic xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xlink:href="fors2662.f1">
  <object-id pub-id-type="pii">456472</object-id>
 </graphic>
</fig>
...
....
